quest.title: Lanterns in the Sea
quest.description: Through Kaeya's informant, you found out that it's a kind of communication marking used by the Treasure Thieves, a criminal organization spanning across Teyvat. It seems this whole thing is not as serious as you originally thought. The Treasure Thieves in Liyue just received an anonymous letter. Out of fear and respect for Xiao, the Treasure Thieves gave the letter to you. The sender requested that someone of high rank from the Treasure Thieves meet with them secretly in Liyue to discuss an important matter. Once again, out of fear and respect for Xiao, they agreed to let you play as a high ranking official of the Treasure Thieves and meet the mysterious sender.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like it's time for the meeting now.

talks.objective: Meet the sender at the meeting spot
Meet the sender at the meeting spot

dialogues.text: Alright, you folks from the Treasure Hoarders, yeah? I thought I insinuated in my letter there that you should have done like I done and put on a mask and a costume and so forth...
...But it seems you didn't all get the memo. Hehehe... it's pretty cool though... gutsy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Well guess what? We don't need to go sneaking around everywhere wearing disguises! Because unlike you, we would never do anything so shameful that we would need to wear masks while doing it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? I was in the middle of my speech and everything!

choices.text: I think he just enjoys dressing up...

response.text: Wait a second now... You folks ain't no Treasure Hoarders! What game are you two playing!?

choices.text: This get up is pretty cool, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tell us your diabolical plan, now! It's over, buster!
Okay! I give up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Give up now or feel the wrath of my Paimonial... Huh? You're giving up just like that?
I, uh... I'm just a lowly apprentice thief who really looks up to the Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An apprentice thief!?
Yeah... For a greenhorn like me, 'specially working on my own an' all... The Treasure Hoarders? Man, they're my heroes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second, so—
...So, I thought I'd try and set up some sorta lucrative opportunity, then submit my pledge of loyalty...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! None of this is making any sense!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was expecting a serial arsonist to be someone more... sinister! Evil-looking! But instead... We get you!?
...Arson? What the heck are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't pretend! Paimon's seen you, loitering around piles of highly flammable materials!
Oh... Oh yeah, yeah, I know where you're talkin' about. But I was only checking the place out.
My plan ain't got nothing to do with those lantern construction materials.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Are you serious!?
I just wanted to nab me the biggest chunk of Plaustrite in twenty years is all...
I was gonna wait till nightfall, chop off half the tethers, float it out to sea...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...
Then all I'd have to do is find some way or another of bringing it down, so I could hide it underwater in the shallows. The perfect crime!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, for a perfect crime, it sure has a lot of holes... For example, how exactly were you planning to bring down the Plaustrite once it was airborne?
I was still in the process of figuring out the details, hence why I hadn't made my move yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy is an imbecile!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, {NICKNAME}, let's teach him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go find Yaksha-man and debrief.

talks.objective: Talk to Xiao at the meeting spot

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I see. Human stupidity is infinite in its randomness... But it is of no consequence to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Now. I am here, at the place you insisted upon. The Mingxiao Lantern is in sight. Why did you summon me here?

choices.text: To see the Mingxiao Lantern, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You are obviously one of the heroes this festival is all about... Why don't you want to get involved?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I cannot be near crowds of people. Carefree, happy crowds of people... I simply cannot.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Too long have I spent suffering and slaughtering. It is all I know...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I will discuss it no further.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Though, if while you are in Liyue you encounter any trouble of a supernatural nature, call my name.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Whether yours or Liyue's, I hear all cries for help, all prayers for peace, and all the wishes carried by the lanterns.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you... and Happy New Year.

choices.text: To celebrate Lantern Rite, of course.

talks.objective: Go back to Liyue Harbor and witness the last day of Lantern Rite
